stop_rules: Any writer input leak, forbidden network use, changed data/prompt/skill tree, or unexplained requested/actual model mismatch or changed requested effort stops all new calls.

Any missing required token or requested-effort provenance pauses new calls until reconciled; expected Codex USD null is disclosed, not a missing-cost error or zero resource cost.
Any canary or renderer failure stops launch; no weakened canary.
Writer timeout/cap/invalid artifact occupies its slot; keep failure and scheduled pair denominator. No replacement writer.
Retry exhaustion stops the current operation; preserve partial results and prevent automatic whole-pair retry.
No live editing of stories/skills in response to interim outcomes.
